patches_added.name: GXR face bridge (version 5002318 and below)
patches_added.description: For exact older Steam Link builds only. Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).

patches_added.name: GXR tongue bridge (version 5002322 and above)
patches_added.description: For modern Steam Link builds with Valve's native Android XR face mapping. Currently verified and enabled only for exact build 5002322; newer builds require a separately verified native layout. Preserves Valve's face expressions and standard TongueOut while exposing Galaxy XR tongue out/left/right/up/down to the matching Galaxy XR VRCFT module.
